units.source_text: 六条妃子车上的驾辕台都被折毁了。

en.t: The shaft platform on Lady Rokujo's carriage had been completely broken.

units.source_text: 只得将辕搁在别人家的破烂车子的毂上，才得站稳，样子实甚寒酸。

en.t: They had no choice but to rest the shafts on the hubs of someone else's shabby old carriage before it would stand steady, and it looked terribly wretched.
She bitterly regretted it, thinking, Why did I have to come here?
But it was already too late for regrets.

units.source_text: 她想不要看了，立刻回去吧。

en.t: She thought she would stop trying to watch and go home at once.

units.source_text: 然而被别人的车子挡住，无路可通！

en.t: But other people's carriages blocked her in, leaving no way through.

units.source_text: 正在懊恼之际，但闻众人喊道：“来了，来了！”

en.t: Just as she was fretting in distress, she heard everyone shouting, He is coming, he is coming!

units.source_text: 可知源氏大将的行列即将来到了。

en.t: It was clear that General Genji's procession was about to arrive.

units.source_text: 六条妃子听到这喊声，觉得如此可恨之人，却必须在此恭候他的驾临，实在委屈之至！

en.t: When Lady Rokujo heard those cries, she felt unbearably wronged that she had to wait here respectfully for the arrival of someone she found so hateful.

units.source_text: 她虽想一见源氏大将，但这里又不是“竹丛林荫处”[\[6\]](#part1338.html#m6)，源氏大将不知道她来，没有驻马回头看她，终于扬长而去。

en.t: Although she wanted to catch a glimpse of General Genji, this was not the shaded place among the bamboo groves, and since Genji did not know she had come, he did not stop his horse or turn back to look at her, but simply rode grandly away.

units.source_text: 她觉得这比完全不见更加可恨。

en.t: To her, this felt even more hateful than not seeing him at all.
